summary: The authors tested whether SCN transcripts oscillated within chow-fed and HFD-fed mice. HypoExplorer estimates the common HFD-minus-chow difference in expression at matched times. The article, all eight supplements, GEO files and repository searches yielded no author gene-level estimate of that difference.

manualReview.summary: The two deposited SCN expression matrices match the registered input hashes. Published SCN gene statistics measure within-diet rhythmicity.
manualReview.note: Tognini et al. studied male C57BL/6J mice after ten weeks of chow or HFD. All 36 SCN library labels match the registered diet, ZT and replicate assignments. HypoExplorer fits limma-trend to log2(FPKM + 1) with categorical ZT and one HFD-minus-chow coefficient across ZT0, 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20. Datasets S5 and S6 report per-diet JTK_CYCLE period, lag, amplitude, P and Q alongside replicate expression. The two-way ANOVA workbooks measure metabolites. Figure S7 tests selected mPFC transcripts by qPCR. The remaining supplement sheets and panels cover rhythmicity, enrichment or metabolite–enzyme associations. The source inventory, checksums and six comparability dimensions are in data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE157077/codex-2026-11-24/SEARCH_LOG.md.
reviewFlags: The common SCN diet coefficient has no published author comparator in the reviewed sources. Effect agreement, author diet-test P values and FDR remain unassessed.
The SI Appendix names a HiSeq 2500. GEO and ENA name a HiSeq 4000 for the deposited libraries. This instrument metadata difference does not affect the contrast decision.

verificationReview.reason: The 36 libraries and six sampling times are consistent across the deposited SCN series and the registered cohort. The published SCN RNA result tests oscillation separately in each diet, with phase and amplitude summaries for common oscillators. The registered model tests a common HFD-minus-chow shift in expression conditional on ZT. No signed gene effect or test of that shift was located, including among labeled panels and selected-gene results.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if the study authors release signed gene-level HFD-minus-chow estimates for this SCN cohort across the same matched ZTs, with identifiers, effect scale and contrast definition. Assess any selected-gene result within its published scope and assess P or FDR only where supplied.

openIssues: A study-author estimate of the common matched-ZT SCN diet effect would reopen this review. Author agreement and inference for that coefficient remain unassessed.
The SI Appendix and repository records name different sequencer models. Public sample records identify SCN libraries and biological replicates but lack individual-animal identifiers.
